variant_master_table_clinvar.variant_id: BioChirp-internal ClinVar variant identifier in the form CLINVAR:<int> (e.g. CLINVAR:12345) — primary join key; raw NCBI VCV/RCV accessions are NOT stored on disk
variant_master_table_clinvar.variant_name: HGVS or descriptive name of the variant; e.g. NM_007294.4(BRCA1):c.5266dupC (p.Gln1756Profs), c.1799T>A
variant_master_table_clinvar.variant_gene_symbol: gene symbol denormalized in variant_master — route gene queries to gene_master_table_clinvar via variant_gene_association_clinvar.gene_id FK
variant_master_table_clinvar.variant_type: class of variant; e.g. single nucleotide variant, Indel, Duplication, Deletion, Microsatellite, Complex
variant_master_table_clinvar.aggregate_clinical_significance: ClinVar aggregate clinical interpretation across all submitters; e.g. pathogenic, likely pathogenic, uncertain significance, likely benign, benign
variant_master_table_clinvar.aggregate_review_status: aggregate review status for the consensus ClinVar classification; e.g. reviewed by expert panel, criteria provided single submitter, no assertion criteria provided
variant_master_table_clinvar.origin_simple: germline or somatic origin of the variant; e.g. germline, somatic, unknown
variant_master_table_clinvar.chromosome: chromosome where the variant is located; e.g. 1, 2, X, Y, MT
variant_master_table_clinvar.start: genomic start position (1-based) on the chromosome
variant_master_table_clinvar.stop: genomic stop position (1-based) on the chromosome

gene_master_table_clinvar.gene_id: NCBI Gene ID — primary join key
gene_master_table_clinvar.gene_symbol: HGNC gene symbol; e.g. BRCA1, CFTR, TP53, EGFR

variant_disease_association_clinvar.disease_id: BioChirp-internal disease identifier (CLINVAR_DIS:<id>) — join key to disease records; NOT a MedGen/OMIM/SNOMED ID. External xrefs (MedGen, OMIM, Orphanet) are in variant_genomic_coords_clinvar.clndisdb
variant_disease_association_clinvar.variant_disease_name: name of the disease or condition associated with the variant; e.g. Hereditary breast and ovarian cancer syndrome, Cystic fibrosis, Parkinson disease
variant_disease_association_clinvar.disease_clinical_significance: ClinVar clinical interpretation of the variant for this specific disease; e.g. pathogenic, likely pathogenic, uncertain significance, benign
variant_disease_association_clinvar.variant_phenotype_ids: pipe-separated external phenotype identifiers (MedGen, OMIM, Orphanet, MONDO, HP) for the associated disease

variant_submission_clinvar.submission_clinical_significance: individual submitter's interpretation of clinical significance for this submission
variant_submission_clinvar.date_last_evaluated: date the submitter last evaluated the variant interpretation
variant_submission_clinvar.description: free-text description or notes from the submitter about this interpretation
variant_submission_clinvar.submitted_phenotype: phenotype or condition as reported by the submitter
variant_submission_clinvar.reported_phenotype: standardised phenotype name after ClinVar curation
variant_submission_clinvar.submission_review_status: review status of this specific submission from the submitting laboratory
variant_submission_clinvar.collection_method: method used to collect evidence; e.g. clinical testing, research, literature only. Missing values are stored as NULL on disk (NOT as the string "not provided"). Note: 29 compound semicolon-joined values also exist on disk (e.g. "clinical testing;curation", "research;clinical testing") that are not listed in the enum — use str.contains() for partial matching on these compound forms.
variant_submission_clinvar.submitter: name of the submitting laboratory or organisation
variant_submission_clinvar.scv: SCV accession for this specific submitter interpretation
variant_submission_clinvar.submitted_gene_symbol: gene symbol as submitted (may differ from canonical HGNC)
variant_submission_clinvar.explanation: explanation of conflicts in the submission
variant_submission_clinvar.somatic_clinical_impact: somatic clinical impact classification where applicable
variant_submission_clinvar.contributes_to_aggregate: flag indicating whether this submission contributes to the aggregate classification

variant_citation_clinvar.citation_allele_id: ClinVar allele ID — internal join key
variant_citation_clinvar.rsid: dbSNP rsID stored as bare numeric string WITHOUT rs prefix (e.g. "397704705"); strip the 'rs' prefix from user input before matching
variant_citation_clinvar.nsv: dbVar NSV structural variant ID where applicable
variant_citation_clinvar.citation_source: source database for the citation. Three values on disk: PubMed (3,935,444 rows), PubMedCentral (625,551 rows), NCBIBookShelf (9,693 rows). OMIM does not appear as a citation_source value.
variant_citation_clinvar.citation_id: identifier in the citation source; e.g. PubMed PMID

variant_genomic_coords_clinvar.genomic_allele_id: ClinVar allele ID — internal join key
variant_genomic_coords_clinvar.assembly: genome assembly version; e.g. GRCh38, GRCh37
variant_genomic_coords_clinvar.ref: reference allele nucleotide(s); e.g. A, GCTA
variant_genomic_coords_clinvar.clndn: ClinVar disease name(s) associated with this allele
variant_genomic_coords_clinvar.clndisdb: disease database cross-references in the VCF record
variant_genomic_coords_clinvar.gene_info: NCBI gene info for this locus
variant_genomic_coords_clinvar.molecular_consequence: molecular effect of the variant; e.g. missense variant, synonymous variant, stop gained, frameshift variant
variant_genomic_coords_clinvar.variant_class: variant class code; e.g. single_nucleotide_variant, Deletion, Duplication, Microsatellite, Indel, Insertion, Inversion, Variation

disease_master_table_clinvar.disease_id: BioChirp-internal disease identifier (CLINVAR_DIS:<md5>) — primary key; NOT a MedGen/OMIM/SNOMED ID
disease_master_table_clinvar.disease_name: canonical disease name derived from ClinVar PhenotypeList; e.g. Hereditary breast and ovarian cancer syndrome, Cystic fibrosis, Parkinson disease. NOT queryable: this is the KG-only master; disease-name filtering routes to the exec-visible variant_disease_association.variant_disease_name (concept_type disease_name) — making this queryable created planner ambiguity → values routed here cannot execute (exec_schema:false) → "No filter terms".
disease_master_table_clinvar.phenotype_ids: pipe-separated external phenotype identifiers (MedGen, OMIM, Orphanet, MONDO, HP) associated with this disease. NOT queryable (KG-only master, exec_schema:false).
